title: Emu Plains Market
summary: Seasonal makers market at Emu Plains Reserve, Balnarring, with craft, design, vintage, food and live music. The organiser confirms daytime markets on the third Saturdays of October, November and December 2026, 9am to 2pm.

heroImage.alt: Conceptual market produce and ceramics beneath a striped canopy.

recurrenceNote: Third Saturday October through December 2026, 9am to 2pm. January 2027 is a separately timed twilight market.
accessibilityNotes: Grassed reserve; generally accessible; uneven ground in places
provenance: The organiser's dated November page and market calendar were checked on 2026-11-16. They list 21 November 2026, 9am to 2pm, at Emu Plains Reserve, with paid parking, disabled toilets and no dogs on DEECA land. The same calendar lists 19 December at 9am to 2pm. January is a separately timed 3pm to 8pm twilight market and must not inherit this record's daytime hours.
nearbyAttractions: Balnarring Village; Balnarring Beach; Merricks wineries
editorVerdict: Emu Plains is the artisan market that actually feels like the Peninsula: stringybarks, music, makers you'd buy from twice.
editorNote:
The organiser confirms 17 October, 21 November and 19 December 2026 as 9am–2pm markets at Emu Plains Reserve. Its January session is a separately timed twilight market, so check the organiser before making plans for dates beyond December.

The move: browse the makers and food stalls, then continue to Balnarring Beach or nearby Coolart Wetlands.
